notes.title: Grenade: new visuals and gameplay changes
notes.content:
This month, I've listened to players' feedback about the demo, and the main complaints were:

- The grenade throw is not satisfying enough (which is a shame, considering it's one of the main actions of the game).
- Many players find it odd that the grenade effect is required to obtain ammo drops.

I've tackled both issues.

First things first, the visuals. I've spent so much time redesigning the visuals, audio, and feedback of the grenade throw that now it seems 200% better to me. 

Secondly, I've removed the grenade requirement for enemies to drop ammo. Now, enemies drop a small amount of ammo regardless, and using a grenade simply increases the amount of ammo dropped.

Now, the grenade primarily serves as a support weapon, amplifying firearms damage and combining with the sword and certain weapon add-ons.

I'm curious to hear what you think.
Steph

notes.title: Great changes in the last demo update!
notes.content:
I've just updated the demo right before the Steam FPS Fest, fixing a few bugs and enhancing the first open area to make it more compelling and interesting to begin with.

I've also added more graphics quality settings to assist players with low-end devices in enjoying the game.

Coming soon: windowed mode and custom resolutions.

In late April, I will implement full control customization.

So, play the new and updated version of the demo and have fun!
